notes: Real files from ANVISA's open-data server, https://dados.anvisa.gov.br/dados/ (CONSULTAS/PRODUTOS/ for the product files, CONSULTAS/EMPRESA_FISCALIZACAO_PRODUTO/ for produtos irregulares and the CBPF certificates, the root for the petition files; no auth). The CSVs are too big to keep, so headers_*.txt holds the response headers and *_head.csv the header row plus a handful of records copied byte for byte (never re-encode them; .gitattributes marks them -text). Records were chosen to cover the format's edge cases: Windows-1252 bytes 0x92/0x96/0x99, quotes inside quoted fields that ANVISA does not escape, line breaks inside fields, HTML entities in MARCAS and NO_PRODUTO, DT_VENCIMENTO_REGISTRO as MMYYYY and MM/YYYY, ST_PRODUTO_ATIVO = X, CNPJs with leading zeros, and resultado rows that join main rows on CO_SEQ_APRESENTACAO_PRODUTO. tokens.json is not a response: it is the 40 tokenizer cases shared with anvisa-dash (see busca.py), copied from that repository on 2026-10-09. chaves.json is the second shared contract: the manufacturer key (chave) cases that derivar.chave_sql and the site's chave()/chaveSql() must both satisfy, written here on 2026-10-23 and copied to anvisa-dash.

responses.name: medicamentos
responses.note: the medicamentos registry (registros válidos, dictionary V1 of 2020-12, monthly): 228,869 records but only 42,661 distinct, product × processo rows repeated; registro 9 digits, never the 13-digit apresentação; dd/mm/yyyy dates, vencimento as mmyyyy; EMPRESA_DETENTORA_REGISTRO joins CNPJ and name; categories with a literal ? and 12-char truncation. Details in headers_medicamentos.txt

responses.name: produtos_saude
responses.note: produtos para saúde (dispositivos médicos), one row per registro × fabricante, 116,008 rows and 100,681 registros; the only open-data file that quotes nothing (`Sistema "Holter"` inside values), hence Dataset.quoted=False; VALIDADE is a date or the word VIGENTE; DT_ATUALIZACAO_DADO is month first while DT_PUB is day first. No dictionary on the server (the PDFs named PRODUTO_SAUDE describe the petition lifecycle). Details in headers_produtos_saude.txt

responses.name: cbpf
responses.note: CBPF/CBPDA certificate petições of every area but medicines, one row per petição (80 exact copies), 8,042,875 bytes, not kept; 41 records chosen for: a petição four times and one twice, CBPDA, own/same-root/third-party plant CNPJs, A/B/C foreign codes, empty plant, indeferido, cancelado, revalidação sem validade, Certificado emitido, inner quotes, &#8203- and COM&Eacute-RCIO (entities whose ; became -), 0x96, trailing whitespace, 7/13/15/16/17-digit processos, every emissão family, the validade-on-the-carga-day row, and holders in other samples (54516661000101, 21551379000106, 44734671000151, 60409075000152). Dates month first. TA_CONSULTA_CBPF_DETALHE.CSV (same folder) is stale, DT_CARGA_ETL 2025-09-08, and is not a dataset. Dictionary: Documentacao_e_Dicionario_de_Dados_Certificado_de_Boas_Praticas.pdf. Details in headers_cbpf.txt

responses.name: cbpf_medicamentos
responses.note: the medicines' CBPF/CBPDA certificates, one row per certified line (14,803 rows, 13,651 petições), 9,844,514 bytes, not kept; stale: DT_CARGA_ETL is 2025-09-08 on every row though Last-Modified is 2026-05-15 (TA_CONSULTA_CBPF_MEDICAMENTO.CSV, the main file, has 4 rows and is not a dataset). RAZAOSOCIAL is the inspected plant, not the solicitante the dictionary says; DS_MOTIVO_CANCELAMENTO carries `¿` for lost characters; TIPOPETICAO is the kind of medicine. No petição id in common with TA_CONSULTA_CBPF.CSV. 32 records, 22 whole petições. Details in headers_cbpf_medicamentos.txt
